rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a 2AB-style blastocyst description, including a loose TE and identifiable ICM, but it overstates precision from the image (e.g., uniform zona, exact blastocoel proportion, well-defined compact ICM) and labels asymmetry/other details that are not clearly assessable.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, BMI, prior cycle, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle into prognosis reasonably well, though some links are speculative and not all factors are weighted appropriately.

The response is structured and generally logical, but several conclusions rely on weak or unsupported assumptions, such as implying mosaicism risk from Day 4 development and using an additive probability model without clear evidence basis.

While much of the general IVF framing is acceptable, several recommendations are not well aligned with routine evidence-based practice, including ERA after a single failed cycle, assisted hatching for TE grade B, growth hormone co-stimulation, and suggesting mosaicism concern from early blastulation.

It provides concrete next steps for transfer support and contingency planning, including further investigations and protocol review, but some suggested actions are not appropriately prioritized or evidence-based for this specific case.
